Kemence is a bowed string musical instrument from Turkey. Ussak cesni is a commonly used in makam music of Turkey.

The Ney is an end-blown flute that figures prominently in Middle Eastern music (it is impossible to get a sound out of it unless you practice a lot). This recording was done in a music store in the Beyoglu suburb of Istanbul (Turkey).
